slides.headline: The fixer everyone scrolls past could be your best buy
things to check before you write off a fixer
slides.body: Look past the peeling paint and the overgrown yard. The roof, the foundation, and the floor plan are what matter. Cosmetic work is cheap next to structural surprises, and a good inspection tells you which one you're looking at.

slides.headline: Price the repairs before you price the offer.
slides.body: Get real numbers from a contractor before you negotiate. Knowing the repair cost turns a scary listing into a clear math problem, and it gives you leverage at the table.
